_comment: What the public manual and this repository's public legacy-identifiers export may not contain, in ONE place.
Read by manual/scripts/check_operator_strings.py (the manual's sources through
backend/tests/unit/test_manual_has_no_operator_strings.py, and the BUILT site in deploy-manual.yml) and by
the suite census when it writes docs/legacy-identifiers.public.md. Each rule: `name` (what a finding reports),
`pattern` (a Python regular expression), `flags` (`i` = ignore case; the only flags read are i, m and s).

forbidden.name: private address 192.168.x
forbidden.why: The reference deployment's private network. Use <ingress-ip>.

forbidden.name: private address 10.152.x
forbidden.why: The cluster's pod and service network.

forbidden.name: operator host *.hitsai.local
forbidden.why: A LAN host name of the reference deployment. Use miworkbench.example.local or <your-host>.

forbidden.name: operator host *.hitsai.net
forbidden.why: A deployment host. The three public MCP endpoints are published in the setup guide, and the manual names its own custom domain (042 FR-042.2: docs-miworkbench, the WHOLE host and nothing wider; mcp-workbench joined at P4, FR-042.32; the old mcp-studio left at P7, FTASKS 18.8). An allowed host must END there: a bare word boundary admitted docs-miworkbench.hitsai.net.local and mcp-studio.hitsai.net.attacker.example (review rev-mistudio-p0 F4); a single sentence-ending period is still allowed.

forbidden.name: private repository owner
forbidden.why: The private source organisation; the public mirror is hitsainet.

forbidden.name: literal bearer token
forbidden.why: A literal bearer value, not a placeholder ($VAR, <token>, ${...}).
